name: Pogranichye World Materials

unity_notes.normal: Texture Type = Normal map for separate normal maps
unity_notes.roughness: sRGB off; invert to Smoothness when feeding URP Lit
unity_notes.pbr_packed: sRGB off, readable, uncompressed; RG=normal XY, B=AO, A=roughness. Runtime stores X in both R/A for RG or AG normal unpacking, reconstructs Z, and converts roughness to smoothness.

notes: The ten procedural sets are generated by Blender and are not checked-in PNGs until that step runs. The homespun linen set is already checked in.
